name: contentful-backup-lambda
description: Backup Lambda: exports Contentful, archives, stages, verifies and promotes to S3
//dependencyNotes: All dependencies are on their LATEST versions. archiver 8 is pure ESM ("type": "module") and no longer exports a callable default — it exports Archiver/ZipArchive/TarArchive/JsonArchive CLASSES. index.js therefore uses `const { ZipArchive } = require('archiver')` and `new ZipArchive({ zlib: { level: 9 } })`. No ESM conversion of this function was needed: Node 24's require(esm) interop loads the namespace from CommonJS, and ZipArchive extends Archiver so every instance method used here (.directory/.pipe/.finalize/.on) is unchanged from 7.x. Verified functionally against real zip output, not only against stubs.
